scripts.build: node site/hosting/prepare-build.js && vite build && node site/hosting/finalize-build.js && node site/hosting/verify-build.js
scripts.build:pages: vite build --config vite.pages.config.js && node site/hosting/finalize-pages.js && node site/hosting/verify-pages.js
scripts.test: pnpm run test:public && pnpm run test:local-review
scripts.test:public: node --test qa/tests/analytics.test.js qa/tests/calculator.test.js qa/tests/detail-pages.test.js qa/tests/site-integrity.test.js qa/tests/top-input.test.js qa/tests/guide-carousel.test.js
